newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: ATHLETICS-COMMONWEALTH SCHEDULE ALTERED TO ACCOMMODATE WORLD CUP.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-COMMONWEALTH SCHEDULE ALTERED TO ACCOMMODATE WORLD CUP.

text.p: The 1998 Kuala Lumpur Commonwealth Games' athletics schedule has been put back two days to allow eligible athletes to compete at the preceding Johannesburg World Cup.

International Amateur Athletic Federation (IAAF) president Primo Nebiolo told a news conference on Thursday the Games athletics programme would now start on September 16, three days after the end of the three-day World Cup.
Last month Nebiolo said the Commonwealth Games' Federation would have to fit in with the IAAF's timetable and ruled out any change in the dates for the World Cup.

On Thursday at a news conference at the conclusion of the IAAF's annual calendar meeting, Nebiolo said the Commonwealth Games' Federation had decided to start the athletics' programme on September 16 instead of September 14.
"Our athletes will travel on Monday, September 14, arrive in Kuala Lumpur on Tuesday and on Wednesday, September 16 they will compete."
